title: Thyroid Storm Versus Myxedema Coma: Recognition
subject: Medicine
preview: Thyroid storm is life-threatening thyrotoxicosis with severe systemic decompensation such as hyperthermia, tachyarrhythmia or delirium.
quickRevision: Thyroid storm is life-threatening thyrotoxicosis with severe systemic decompensation such as hyperthermia, tachyarrhythmia or delirium.
Both require emergency care and treatment directed to physiology and precipitating factors.
Biochemical results support diagnosis, but treatment decisions in unstable patients are driven by the syndrome.

sections.title: Clinical syndrome and red flags
points: Thyroid storm is life-threatening thyrotoxicosis with severe systemic decompensation such as hyperthermia, tachyarrhythmia or delirium.
Myxedema coma is severe hypothyroidism with hypothermia, altered mental status, hypoventilation or circulatory compromise.

sections.title: Differentiate and manage
points: Both require emergency care and treatment directed to physiology and precipitating factors.
Biochemical results support diagnosis, but treatment decisions in unstable patients are driven by the syndrome.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not confuse the two because both can cause altered consciousness; temperature and cardiovascular findings differ.

quiz.question: Which syndrome is associated with hypothermia and hypoventilation?
quiz.explanation: Myxedema coma is severe hypothyroidism with hypothermia, altered mental status, hypoventilation or circulatory compromise.
